modelIdentification.name: NETN-AIS_Revision
modelIdentification.purpose:
The purpose of the NATO Education and Training Network Automatic Identification System Module (NETN-AIS) is to:
* represent AIS transponder information associated with a vessel or other AIS transponder in an HLA efficient manner where the data is reconstituteable by a gateway into corresponding AIS messages * enable the exchange of AIS data between HLA Federate Applications in real-time and non-real-time platform-level simulation. * allow HLA Federate Applications to use regular HLA object classes and attributes to represent vessel information and leave any translations to physical message formats to dedicated gateways.
modelIdentification.description: AIS is a worldwide automated tracking system used for sharing vessel identification and location information by propagating messages between nearby vessels and Vessel Traffic Services stations.
modelIdentification.useLimitation: The NETN-AIS module is a simulation-oriented representation of AIS data and capabilities. It does not focus on the physical message format defined by the AIS standard ITU-R M.1371-5.

objectClass.name: AIS_Transponder
objectClass.semantics: This class defines additional attributes for AIS transponder. Depending on the kind of AIS equipment, further attributes are added in sub-classes.

attribute.name: MMSI
attribute.semantics: Optional. The MMSI number (Maritime Mobile Service Identity) of the AIS station. If the value is not provided then the subscribing federate that is responsible for the modelling of the AIS station shall generate a value. Note that the value of each AIS station must be unique across all AIS stations in the simulation. Reuse of MMSI numbers if not advised since some systems may retain dead tracks for some time.

attribute.name: Callsign
attribute.semantics: Optional. The callsign of the AIS Station (typically a vessel). The callsign prefix should be in accordance with ITU recommendation for call sign allocation. See https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-R/terrestrial/fmd/Pages/call_sign_series.aspx.

attribute.name: TransmitterStatus
attribute.semantics: Optional. The initial status of the AIS Transmitter(s) of the AIS station. If the value is not provided then the value shall be assumed to be ON.

attribute.name: RadioSystemType-NEW
attribute.semantics: Optional. The type of transmitter. If the value is not provided then the subscribing federate that is responsible for the modelling of the AIS station shall determine the type of transmitter.

objectClass.name: AIS_VesselTransponder
objectClass.semantics: This class defines additional attributes for vessel equipment.

attribute.name: IMO
attribute.semantics: Optional. The International Maritime Organization (IMO) number to identify the vessel. If the value is not provided then the subscribing federate that is responsible for the modelling of the vessel shall generate a value.

attribute.name: ShipType
attribute.semantics: Optional. The type of vessel.

attribute.name: DimensionToStern
attribute.semantics: Optional. Distance in meters to stern, in accordance with ITU-R M.1371-5 (02/2014).

attribute.name: DimensionToBow
attribute.semantics: Optional. Distance in meters to bow, in accordance with ITU-R M.1371-5 (02/2014).

attribute.name: DimensionToPort
attribute.semantics: Optional. Distance in meters to port, in accordance with ITU-R M.1371-5 (02/2014).

attribute.name: DimensionToStarboard
attribute.semantics: Optional. Distance in meters to starboard, in accordance with ITU-R M.1371-5 (02/2014).

attribute.name: Draught
attribute.semantics: Optional. Draught, in accordance with ITU-R M.1371-5 (02/2014).

attribute.name: ETAtime
attribute.semantics: Optional: The Estimated time of arrival. Default: Not available.

attribute.name: Destination
attribute.semantics: Optional (Default: not available, 20 six-bit "@" value). 20 six-bit characters for the destination. For SAR aircraft, the use of this field may be decided by the responsible administration.

objectClass.name: AIS_AidToNavigationTransponder
objectClass.semantics: This class defines additional attributes for aid to navigation (ATON) equipment. Will cover Message 21 data

attribute.name: AidType
attribute.semantics: Optional. Type of AtoN.

attribute.name: VirtualFlag
attribute.semantics: Optional (Default: false). Virtual-aid flag. The Virtual Aid flag is interpreted as follows: false = real Aid to Navigation at the indicated position; true = virtual Aid to Navigation simulated by nearby AIS station.

attribute.name: OffPositionFlag
attribute.semantics: Optional (Default: false). Off-Position Indicator. The Off-Position Indicator is for floating Aids-to-Navigation only: false means on position; true means off position. Only valid if UTCsecond is available.

simpleData.name: MMSIInteger32
simpleData.semantics: A 30-bit value. The MMSI number (Maritime Mobile Service Identity) is a unique nine-digit number for identifying an AIS station.

simpleData.name: UnitModelInteger8
simpleData.semantics: A 4-bit value. (Part B) Unit Model Code.

simpleData.name: IMOInteger32
simpleData.semantics:
A 30-bit value. The International Maritime Organization (IMO) number is a unique identifier for vessels. See https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-R.
The IMO number is made of the three letters "IMO" followed by a seven-digit number. This number consists of a six-digit sequential unique number followed by a check digit. The integrity of an IMO number can be verified using its check digit. This is done by multiplying each of the first six digits by a factor of 2 to 7 corresponding to their position from right to left. The rightmost digit of this sum is the check digit. For example, for IMO 9074729: (9×7) + (0×6) + (7×5) + (4×4) + (7×3) + (2×2) = 139.
This attribute represents the 7 digits value of the IMO number. The value shall be zero for not available (default). The value shall also be zero for inland vessels.

simpleData.name: DegreesPerSecondFloat32
simpleData.semantics: The turn rate in decimal degrees per second, where: (a) zero value: not turning; (b) positive value: turning right; (c) negative value: turning left.

simpleData.name: DraughtMeterFloat32
simpleData.semantics: The vertical distance between the waterline and the bottom of the hull (keel) including the thickness of the hull; Draught determines the minimum depth of water a ship or boat can safely navigate.
